data.one_liner: An OBS WebSocket client written in Dart for remote-controlling Open Broadcaster Software.
data.what_it_does: Allows Dart and Flutter applications to connect to the obs-websocket plugin running inside OBS Studio. It provides helper methods for all protocol requests, supports auto-reconnection, handles events, and manages authentication.
use_when: Building a custom remote control companion app for OBS Studio
Automating streaming and recording workflows using Dart or Flutter
avoid_when: Building general-purpose WebSocket connections unrelated to OBS
strengths: Full coverage of the obs-websocket v5.x protocol requests and events
Built-in auto-reconnection with exponential backoff and connection state stream
Environment variable and .env file configuration support
weaknesses: Requires a running instance of OBS with the obs-websocket plugin configured
Does not handle video rendering or local stream encoding directly
data.setup_notes: Requires the OBS application (v27.x or above) installed with the obs-websocket plugin enabled and reachable on the network.
